entities.summary: Merav Michaeli is an Israeli politician, journalist, TV anchor, radio broadcaster, feminist and activist currently serving as a member of the Knesset for the Democrats, which was formed in 2024 by a merger of Labor and Meretz. She served as leader of the Labor Party from 2021 until 2024, and as Minister of Transport in the thirty-sixth government of Israel.
